result.instructions: Tools for Quoter, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show me the draft quotes we created this week."; "Find the contact with the email address jane@example.com."; "List the catalog items in the category Desktop.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Quoter data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run quoter_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run quoter_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run quoter_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. quoter_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: quoter_list_quotes
tools.title: List quotes
tools.description: List quotes with their name, status, draft flag, email status, contact and totals. Filter by draft flag, status, email status, name, custom number or creation date. Quoter API: GET /quotes.

draft.description: Only draft quotes (true) or only finished quotes (false).

status.description: Filter by quote status, for example pending.

email_status.description: Filter by email status, for example sent.

name_contains.description: Only quotes whose name contains this text.

custom_number_contains.description: Only quotes whose custom number contains this text.

created_after.description: Only quotes created after this date or date-time.

tools.name: quoter_create_quote
tools.title: Create a quote
tools.description: Create a new quote for a contact from a quote template. Creates a record in the account. Quoter API: POST /quotes.

contact_id.description: The contact id, for example from a list call.

name.description: Display name for the new quote.

currency_abbr.description: Currency code, for example USD or CAD.

cover_letter.description: Optional cover letter for the quote document.

appended_content.description: Optional extra content appended to the quote document.

tools.name: quoter_add_line_item
tools.title: Add a line item to a quote
tools.description: Add one line item (a product or service with quantity and prices) to an existing quote. Quoter API: POST /line_items.

quote_id.description: The quote id, for example from a list call.

category.description: Category the line item belongs to, for example Desktop.

unit_price.description: Price per unit to the customer.

unit_cost.description: Cost per unit to the business.

recurring.description: True for a recurring line item.

taxable.description: True if tax applies to the line item.

annotations.title: Add a line item to a quote

tools.name: quoter_list_contacts
tools.title: List contacts
tools.description: List customer contacts with name, organization, email, phone and billing address. Filter by email, city, country or region. Quoter API: GET /contacts.

email.description: Only contacts with this exact email address.

city_contains.description: Only contacts whose billing city contains this text.

country.description: Billing country ISO code, for example US or CA.

region.description: Billing region ISO code, for example CA or ON.

tools.name: quoter_get_contact
tools.title: Get a contact
tools.description: Get one contact by id, with name, organization, email, phone, billing and shipping address. Quoter API: GET /contacts/{id}.

contact_id.description: The contact id, for example from a list call.

tools.name: quoter_create_contact
tools.title: Create a contact
tools.description: Create a customer contact. Email, first name, last name, organization and billing country are required by Quoter. Quoter API: POST /contacts.

billing_country_iso.description: Billing country ISO code, for example US or CA.

billing_region_iso.description: Billing region ISO code, for example CA or ON.

tools.name: quoter_update_contact
tools.title: Update a contact
tools.description: Change some fields of one contact. Only the fields you pass are changed; the tool returns the updated contact. Quoter API: PATCH /contacts/{id}.

contact_id.description: The contact id, for example from a list call.

tools.name: quoter_list_items
tools.title: List catalog items
tools.description: List catalog items with name, code, SKU, category, manufacturer, supplier, prices and cost. Filter by name, code, SKU, category, manufacturer or supplier id. Quoter API: GET /items.

name_contains.description: Only items whose name contains this text.

code.description: Only the item with this exact code.

sku.description: Only the item with this exact SKU.

category_id.description: Only items in this category id.

manufacturer_id.description: Only items from this manufacturer id.

supplier_id.description: Only items from this supplier id.

tools.name: quoter_get_item
tools.title: Get a catalog item
tools.description: Get one catalog item by id, with its prices, cost, category, manufacturer and supplier. Quoter API: GET /items/{id}.

item_id.description: The catalog item id, for example from a list call.

tools.name: quoter_list_categories
tools.title: List categories
tools.description: List catalog categories, with their parent category. Filter by name or parent category id. Quoter API: GET /categories.

name_contains.description: Only categories whose name contains this text.

parent_category_id.description: Only categories under this parent category id.

tools.name: quoter_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: List suppliers that catalog items are bought from. Quoter API: GET /suppliers.

tools.name: quoter_list_manufacturers
tools.title: List manufacturers
tools.description: List manufacturers of catalog items. Quoter API: GET /manufacturers.

tools.name: quoter_list_item_groups
tools.title: List item groups
tools.description: List item groups, which bundle catalog items together. Quoter API: GET /item_groups.

tools.name: quoter_list_quote_templates
tools.title: List quote templates
tools.description: List the quote templates that a new quote can be created from. Quoter API: GET /quote_templates.
